combo.description: When looking to start a fight in cougar form W and once you land AA E Q one after another. Follow up with R E Q followed by some AA's.
To get a quick cougar form combo off, AA E then instantly Q. As soon as the Q animation starts hit W.
You can get off some quick damage in cougar form by using AA E then instantly using Q. As soon as the Q animation starts hit W, but click away from your target right before.
For a fast swap out of cougar form use W then quickly R. Q AA as soon as you land.
When in melee range in cougar form, E and instantly W away from your target. R mid air and Q as soon as you land and AA.
If you land a long range Q in human form, instantly R W. Once you land E Q AA quickly one after another.
When you have the opportunity to hit a quick spear in human form Q AA instantly, then E AA as quickly as possible. Use R and W instantly, then AA E Q as fast as you can.
To get a quick burst of damage off in cougar form W and Q mid air, then AA E instantly. As you land follow up with an AA if needed.
